notes: A171871_conjecture: for R >= 1, 1 <= k <= 2^(R-1), A(2^(R-1)+k, R) = T(R, 2^(R-1)+k) = T(R, 2^(R-1)-k), with A, T orbit counts (Nat.card of quotients) of N-word binary codes of length R under the hypercube group, A restricted to classifications (nonconstant, pairwise non-equal/non-complementary columns, every column needed). Key: N > 2^(R-1) words make every coordinate deletion non-injective, so every code is a classification; complement gives T(R,N) = T(R,2^R-N). Axioms propext, Classical.choice, Quot.sound. Outside Lean: the encoding of a classification (set of binary partitions of N unlabeled elements, up to isomorphism) as a code up to the hypercube group (definition reading); OEIS data agreement checked by certificate/check.py for R <= 4.
